text:
Tara: FYI I'm opening a docs PR to reorganize the Private/VPC install networking section — semiaar gap flow, KMS proxy examples, and a new 'offline cert rotation' note. Need two reviewers, one for networking and one for SDK snippets. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference-docs/pull/482
Jonah: I'll take networking. Any specific port-matrix changes?
Tara: Mostly clarify SNAT vs MASQUERADE with Calico + hostNetwork. Added matrix snippet at bottom.
Meera: I'll do SDK snippet review — will replace the old curl examples with js/node SDK chain proxy sample.
Jonah: Quick nit: in the nftables example you used 'tcp dport 443 accept' but our installer opens 8443. Could we show both? :thumbsup:
Tara: good catch, updated. Also added an example for HSM PKCS11 path on SLES.
DocsBot: Link check report: 3 broken links found. files: 'installer/semiairgap.md' -> /vpc/old (404), 'sdk/js-proxy.md' -> outdated anchor.
Meera: I'll patch sdk/js-proxy anchor in a followup commit, can we keep the old anchor as a redirect?
Tara: I pushed a commit with redirect and an inline code sample for node:

```js
const { Redwood } = require('@redwood/inference');
const client = new Redwood({proxy: 'http://proxy.internal:3128'});
await client.generate({model: 'redwood-beta', prompt: 'hello'});
```

Jonah: Can we add a note about env var precedence (HTTPS_PROXY vs sdk.proxy)? I've seen confusion.
Meera: yep adding that line. Also adding a short curl fallback for customers not on node.
Tara: One more: KMS notes — clarifying that HSM requires private cert bundle and time sync. Added a preflight checklist snippet.
Jonah: LGTM from networking side. small wording suggestion on SNAT vs MASQ.
Meera: SDK snippet looks good, I trimmed an extra semicolon and added a link to the E2E test harness.
Tara: Thanks both. I'll squash and request final review. Targeting merge after smoke test passes. :rocket:
Jonah: I'll run the smoke test, ping here when done.
SmokeTestBot: smoke tests passed on staging-priv-vpc (build 482.3)
Tara: Merging. Will open a follow-up for the redirect cleanup in two weeks.
Meera: great, thanks!
Jonah: nice work :clap:
